d: MLC Election 2026 ki 8 siton ke natijon aur aae bare rajnitik ulatpher par bihar ke upmukhyamantri vijay kumar sinha ka pahla aur bara bayan samne aaya hai. vijay sinha ne emaelsi chunav men endie ke pradarshan par santosh jatate hue rajy ke prabuddh shikshak aur snatak matdataon ka aabhar jataya hai.
